name: Demis Hassabis
current_role: CEO and co-founder, Isomorphic Labs; chairman and co-founder, Google DeepMind; chief scientist, Alphabet (stepped down as DeepMind CEO Aug 2026)
profile: Sir Demis Hassabis is a British AI researcher who co-founded DeepMind (sold to Google in 2014) and in 2021 launched Isomorphic Labs, Alphabet's AI drug-discovery company. He shared the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry with John Jumper for AlphaFold's protein-structure prediction and was knighted in 2024.
interesting_fact: A chess prodigy, he reached master standard at 13 (Elo 2300) and, at 17, co-designed and lead-programmed the hit 1994 game Theme Park with Peter Molyneux.
deep_cut_fact: He landed his first games job by entering an Amiga Power 'Win-a-job-at-Bullfrog' competition in 1992; he bought his first computer, a ZX Spectrum 48K, with chess winnings. He is also a five-time Mind Sports Olympiad Pentamind world champion.
notes: Extremely high-demand guest; Isomorphic press office is the realistic route. Lifelong Liverpool FC fan; Sebastian Mallaby biography 'The Infinity Machine' (2026).

name: Shi Qiming
current_role: Executive Vice President, DCG (Wuhan Polytechnic Digital Communication Group)
profile: Shi Qiming is an executive of DCG, a Wuhan Optics Valley company founded in 2014 that provides big-data and media-convergence technology to Chinese publishers (RAYS system). DCG was named a 2023 China Unicorn Enterprise and in 2024 launched BOOKSGPT, a publishing-focused large AI model.
interesting_fact: He said DCG had created more than 10 'AI editors' with BOOKSGPT that, 'like real people', take part in production stages at publishing houses.
notes: Hurun lists him as a DCG founder; public sources show him as EVP. No published contact found; Chinese-language channels (WeChat) likely the route.

name: Christophe Chong
current_role: Co-founder (and CTO at founding), Kikoff (San Francisco)
profile: Christophe Chong co-founded Kikoff in late 2019 with CEO Cynthia Chen. Kikoff is a credit-building fintech offering an interest- and fee-free line of credit reported to the credit bureaus, plus credit monitoring; it had ~1M users and ~140 staff in 2025. Backers include Lightspeed, Portage and Steph Curry.
interesting_fact: Kikoff's founders say they came from low-to-moderate-income immigrant/first-generation families and built Kikoff to help people establish credit from scratch.
deep_cut_fact: Before Kikoff he was head of growth at scooter company Lime and earlier led growth teams at Facebook and Square.
notes: No published press email found (only customer support). Low personal profile; CEO Cynthia Chen is the public face.
